== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The early slip expressly requires the Probe Droid to be in battle to provide the total battle destiny bonus. The later text states the bonus here without that requirement. Both retain presence, three reductions on Imperial deployments and the opponent-hand peek when drawn for destiny.
